answer.rationale: The two measured declines are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), so the decision is really between simplify_onboarding (memory_86, memory_31) and activation_messaging (memory_91). I spend the verification budget on exactly those two competing records rather than on memories that do not change the choice. memory_86 is the closest-matched and most recent support for the onboarding path, but it is 24 days old and I want the original record's effect size, segment definition, and whether the lift held past week one; memory_91 is the strongest rival hypothesis and I want to know whether its week-one engagement gain translated into retained accounts or just earlier clicks. Onboarding completion is upstream of activation, so fixing it plausibly recovers part of both metrics, which is why it is my current intent pending those two pulls. I deliberately reject promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing: memory_73 is the one inherited record with an explicit downside, a 12-point monthly retention drop against an 18% revenue lift, and buying price-sensitive SMB accounts that churn is directly contrary to sustainable long-term qualified revenue. referral_incentive (memory_57) targets established customers and does nothing for the two metrics that are actually falling. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is a real lever but addresses a segment that is not the source of this quarter's decline. Downstream value risk is flagged for two reasons: cutting required signup fields can strip the firmographic data used to route enterprise prospects into the demo-request path that memory_44 says outperforms self-serve, so a self-serve activation win could quietly degrade pipeline quality; and all six memories are consolidated summaries with archived sources, so effect sizes may have drifted since consolidation. I hold the inherited findings as reliable priors, not settled facts, and I run this at standard experiment scale with retention and enterprise-routing tracked as guardrails rather than broad rollout, so a wrong prior is caught cheaply. If verification shows memory_86's lift was short-lived or measured on a segment unlike today's, I switch to activation_messaging.
